parameter.name: label
parameter.label: Label
parameter.description: Human-friendly name for this PIN (must not contain 4+ consecutive digits — leak risk).

parameter.name: disabled
parameter.label: Disabled
parameter.description: Disable this PIN without deleting it.

parameter.name: pinCode
parameter.label: PIN Code
parameter.description: Type the new PIN here (4-8 digits). On save the binding hashes it, stores the hash as a Property, then clears this field. To rotate a PIN, type a new value and save again.
